metadata.description: Node identity mapping for mammals-600 dataset
metadata.mapping_method: Depth-first traversal matching of both trees

notes: Each generated internal node ID (ancestor_otl_NNNNNN) is mapped to original OTL identifiers
MRCA IDs enable querying ChronoSynth for divergence dates
OTT IDs reference the Open Tree of Life taxonomy
Original Newick labels are preserved for reference
Branching nodes (2+ children) are flagged separately from unary internal nodes
